analysis: The PR is documentation-only. docs/provider/cli-reference.md line 1816 and docs/reference/configuration.md line 441 change the documented source path for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift. Both files also bump the 'Last updated' date by one day. No runtime code, authorization, attestation, encryption, coordinator wire protocol or cache-storage behavior is modified, so the TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 and TB-011 controls are untouched. The surrounding unchanged prose in cli-reference.md (prefix cache T-041, App Attest worker opt-in, fan helper, logout/unenroll, report upload) was read and describes existing behavior; it was not re-verified against code and is not new in this PR. The env var is a performance kernel-selection knob with no security semantics. One unverified contract is that the file actually moved to MLXLMCommon, since the source for it is not supplied. If the path is wrong the result is documentation drift only, with no security impact. The configuration.md patch excerpt is truncated, but the range map is complete and shows the changes only at lines 3 and 441. No new attack surface or threat-model invalidation was identified.
